Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Ropecon 2022 organizers just confirmed that they indeed happily welcome VTES EC to Ropecon.

So let's hope the third time is the charm and The Plague, or invading neighbouring countries, won't stop us yet again.

Barring that the EC 2022 will be held at the Ropecon gaming convention in Helsinki during the last weekend of July.

We should be having hotel info up within a week (it is a hotel within few hundred meters from the venue and prices for rooms with "special" prices SHOULD be 110/single, 130/double and 150/double+extra bed. All prices include breakfast, access to hotel sauna and wi-fi.)
